title: A regular matrix level set
promptMarkdown: For $q(A)=A^TA$ with target the symmetric $n\times n$ matrices, prove that $I$ is regular. Determine $T_AO(n)$ and the dimension of $O(n)$. Explain why the same regular-value argument fails if the codomain is declared to be all matrices.
hintLadder: Expand $(A+tB)^T(A+tB)$ and keep its linear term.
Prescribe a symmetric output $S$ and try $B=AS/2$.
Write a kernel vector as $AK$; distinguish $n=1$ in the codomain discussion.
